editorial_note: Sequential technical chapter cuts from five licensed films, not original episodic productions. All story footage and original end credits are retained across each five-chapter sequence. No standalone soundtrack or third-party site artwork is included.
license_note: Creator project licence statements control this pack. PeerTube metadata is inconsistent: Spring is labelled Share Alike and Elephants Dream Unknown there, while their creator pages explicitly specify CC BY 4.0 and CC BY 2.5 respectively. Preserve the captured creator statements.
